description.value: Cardero's is a full-service waterfront restaurant operated by the Sequoia Company of Restaurants (est. 1978), perched at Coal Harbour Marina on the east side of the Westin Bayshore Hotel. It offers an eclectic Pacific Northwest menu heavy on local seafood, with live music daily and panoramic marina views that make it a landmark dining stop on Vancouver's scenic Coal Harbour seawall. The heated enclosed patio and spacious main dining room can accommodate large groups, and the marina-side setting is a natural reward for cyclists finishing a loop around the seawall.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (1583 Coal Harbour Quay) and provides a phone number absent from OSM tags. The menu page explicitly labels items Vegetarian and Gluten-Free, confirming that dietary option. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refills, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere in the website content, so those remain null per the evidence-only rule.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; 604.669.7666 was sourced from website only.

Website footer on Cardero's pages reads 'Sandbar ADDRESS 1583 Coal Harbour Quay' — appears to be a copy-paste template error on the Sequoia company site; main page content consistently identifies the location as Cardero's at that address.
No bike parking information found on website or in OSM tags; the required 'Bike parking or visibility' criterion cannot be confirmed without an on-site check.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Cardero's is an established, active waterfront restaurant directly on the Coal Harbour seawall — one of Vancouver's premier cycling routes — making it a high-value Food & Drink listing for touring cyclists despite unconfirmed bike-specific amenities.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page explicitly labels dietary categories: Oceanwise, Vegetarian, Gluten-Free, and Organic. Menu includes Korean Style Tofu, Szechuan Beans, and salads among vegetarian options
